title: PredMe — Building the Causal Inference Machine
text:
Our vision is to transform how knowledge travels: from language that summarizes, to structure that connects, embedding discovery into every decision.
PredMe is building the Causal Inference Machine — a universal prediction model that consumes scientific papers and datasets, and predicts outcomes. Not next words. Causation.
We help practitioners and scientists prevent unhealthy conditions before they manifest, embedding rigorous science into the way they already work. Biomedicine is where we start. The machine extends to every domain where causation matters — insurance, finance, marketing, policy.
